items.html: And indeed, the matter of the Yod-Hei of Elokim — what their matter is — will be explained below, in the matter of the nursing, for then they are revealed. And behold, this is the reason that the fetus does not speak at all, for it is in the secret of Aleph-Lamed-Mem of Elokim, and therefore it is mute (ilem), without speech. And this is the secret of 'Or who makes a man mute (ilem)?' (Exodus 4:11). For now these Mochin, which clothe in the externality of Ima, called Mi, as is known, are lacking the aspect of the Yesod and the Daat, and this caused the fetus to be still in the secret of the ilem of Elokim, and the entire Name was not revealed. It thus follows that the man, who is ZA, was made mute by Mi.
